cicdAnomaly.title: CI/CD Anomaly Detective
cicdAnomaly.subtitle: Paste a CI log to detect known infrastructure failure patterns

fixes.job_timeout: Raise the job's timeout-minutes or split the job into smaller ones.
fixes.dotnet_test_hang: Run dotnet test with --blame-hang-timeout to get a dump of the hanging test.
fixes.build_lock_wait: Another build holds the cache lock (Cargo, Gradle): give each job its own cache dir.
fixes.step_timeout: Increase the job timeout or split into smaller steps.
fixes.silent_step: Add a heartbeat log or kill on inactivity.
fixes.node_heap: Set NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=… or shard the build.
fixes.jvm_heap: Bump the JVM heap (-Xmx, org.gradle.jvmargs) or split tests into shards.
fixes.dotnet_memory: Lower MSBuild parallelism (-m:1) or use a runner with more memory.
fixes.process_killed: The compiler or test process ran out of memory: lower the parallel jobs or use a bigger runner.
fixes.runner_memory: Bump the runner memory or split the workload.
fixes.npm_peer: Pin the conflicting peer dep, or use --legacy-peer-deps as a temporary patch.
fixes.nuget_conflict: Reference the package version NuGet asks for directly, or use Central Package Management.
fixes.nuget_missing: The package or version is not on the configured feeds: check nuget.config and the version.
fixes.jvm_convergence: Align the versions with dependencyManagement (Maven) or a platform/constraints block (Gradle).
fixes.jvm_resolve: Check the repositories block and the version; refresh with --refresh-dependencies.
fixes.cargo_conflict: Relax the version requirement in Cargo.toml or run cargo update -p <crate>.
fixes.composer_conflict: Run composer why-not <package> <version> and relax the constraint that blocks it.
fixes.pub_conflict: Run flutter pub outdated and relax the constraint pub names in pubspec.yaml.
fixes.pip_conflict: Pin the shared dependency to a version both packages accept (pip install --dry-run shows it).
fixes.bundler_conflict: Run bundle update <gem> or relax its version in the Gemfile.
fixes.spm_conflict: Relax the version rule in Package.swift or reset the package cache (swift package reset).
fixes.go_checksum: go.sum disagrees with the module proxy: run go mod tidy and check GOPROXY / GONOSUMDB.
fixes.resolver_failed: Inspect the resolver output; pin transitives in the lockfile.
fixes.single_version: Pin the offending dep at a single version across the workspace.
fixes.nuget_feed: The NuGet feed did not answer: retry, or check the feed URL and its credentials.
fixes.registry_download: The package registry did not answer: retry with backoff, or cache the packages between runs.
fixes.dns: Add DNS retry / cache the resolution at runner start.
fixes.connection: Wrap the network call in a retry-with-backoff; check upstream status.
fixes.tls: Check the registry's TLS cert / clock skew on the runner.
fixes.disk_cleanup: Add a `df -h` step + cleanup of /tmp + docker prune before the failing step.
fixes.docker_pull_limit: Log in to the registry before pulling, or mirror the image.
fixes.backoff: Add backoff + jitter; or authenticate to a higher-quota tier.
fixes.ssh_key: Refresh the SSH key or PAT used by the runner.
fixes.ci_token: Rotate the CI token; ensure the secret is exposed to the failing job.
fixes.docker_daemon: Restart docker / use a fresh runner image.
fixes.runner_lost: Mark the runner as offline; switch to a healthy pool.
fixes.preempted: The runner was preempted; mark the build as retryable.

license.title: License Governance
license.subtitle: Audit your dependencies' licences against a policy

remediations.weak_copyleft: Acceptable if linked dynamically; review legal exposure.
remediations.strong_copyleft: Replace with a permissive alternative or wall it off behind an IPC boundary.
remediations.network_copyleft: AGPL contaminates SaaS deployments: find an MIT/Apache replacement.
remediations.commercial: Confirm a paid licence covers your usage; track renewals.
remediations.unknown: Look up the upstream licence and add it to the policy.

license.noManifest: No dependency manifest found (package.json, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, *.csproj, pom.xml, build.gradle, Cargo.toml, go.mod, composer, Gemfile.lock, pubspec.lock).
